purpose: W10-A: separate forecast/future-crop availability from physical Inventory and build provider-neutral insurance quote/policy/coverage/claim/payout lifecycle without fictional provider data or automatic physical stock authority.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: Forecast/future crop is never physical Inventory. A ForecastPosition cannot be RESERVED/COMMITTED/SHIPPED/SOLD and cannot satisfy physical-stock verification, custody or title requirements.

ForecastPosition pins organization, commodity/profile version, crop year/period, geography/field reference if available, forecast quantity/range, confidence/evidence source and version/freshness. Manual forecast remains DECLARED/FORECAST, not verified physical availability.

Forward/future Deal basis explicitly identifies FUTURE_CROP origin and its forecast evidence/risk disclosures. Before physical performance stages it must transition through an accepted conversion/availability event that binds actual Inventory, or remain blocked according to policy.
Insurance uses the existing Provider/ProviderCapability/ServiceOffering/IntegrationBinding model. Provider names or static partner copy cannot create an offering or live capability.

InsuranceRequest, Quote, SelectedQuote, Policy, Coverage, Claim, ClaimEvidence, ClaimDecision and PayoutReceipt are separate immutable/versioned facts. A quote/selection is not coverage; policy issuance receipt is required before insured status.

Coverage is pinned to exact insured object/basis, period, risks, limits/deductibles, currency/minor units, provider policy version/reference and accepted terms. No Float money or unversioned text terms become authority.
Claim filing is not claim approval. Provider decision and payout are distinct external receipts; REQUESTED/QUEUED/SENT states never become APPROVED/PAID.
Insurance payout does not directly mutate Deal/Settlement/Inventory. Canonical FinancialObligation/Settlement consumes validated payout/refund facts through a later explicit adapter if applicable.
At least two provider-neutral reference adapters can satisfy the same insurance port without changing core lifecycle, proving multi-provider substitution.
External insurance adapters remain NOT_ACTIVATED without contract, credentials, product mapping and accepted production receipts; fixtures cannot advertise fictional live insurers.
Current tenant/org/member authority is revalidated before request/selection/claim mutation and replay; cross-tenant/same-tenant outsider access to policy/claim data is denied.
Every business mutation commits immutable event, audit, outbox and receipt atomically with payload-bound idempotency and CAS.
Registration, Role Eligibility, physical Inventory, Deal, Settlement, Provider Registry, Federal Accounting lock #4321 and REG.RU topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Tests prove ForecastPosition cannot be used by physical Inventory reservation or represented as verified/custodied/title-cleared stock.
Future Deal basis remains blocked from physical shipment/acceptance until an explicit accepted conversion binds actual canonical Inventory according to policy.
Insurance lifecycle tests distinguish request/quote/selection/policy/claim/decision/payout and reject skipped/fabricated finality.
Two reference provider adapters satisfy the same insurance contract and unsupported capability/provider-not-activated fails closed.
Exact money/coverage limits and immutable term/provider versions are reproduced from receipts and never overwritten by new products/rules.
Cross-tenant/outsider/revoked actor, stale version, duplicate/conflicting replay and audit/outbox failure cases fail closed.
No static fictional provider/catalog or live-success claim appears in accepted runtime paths.
Exact-head CI/review plus real provider/REG.RU acceptance are required before insurance terminal PASS; forecast separation can be accepted internally first.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Actual crop forecast data/provider and field/season evidence may require external sources; internal declared forecast alone is not objective forecast verification.
Real insurance provider contracts/products/credentials and policy/claim/payout receipts remain external blockers.
Future Deal consumer integration depends on W2-E multi-origin DealBasis and W2-D risk acknowledgement.
REG.RU production and real-user future-crop/insurance acceptance remain mandatory.
